Get Basketligaen Season Filter

Source: R/sportality.R
sportality_season_filter.Rd

Series, the 25 seasons (2002/03 on), game types and the default ssgt.

Endpoint: GET https://www.basketligaen.dk/api/sports-v2/season-series-game-types-filter

Usage

sportality_season_filter()

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Series, the 25 seasons (2002/03 on), game types and the default ssgt. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the documented columns come first, in this order (sportsdataverse-py sportality_season_filter), then any column the API added later:

col_nametypedescription
kindcharacterDirectory entry kind: series, season or game_type.
codecharacterSeries code (DBL = Basketligaen).
namecharacterGame type name in Danish (Grundspil = regular season, Slutspil = playoffs).
uuidcharacterSeries uuid (platform key space); the seriesUuid of /sports-v2/game-schedule.
deletedlogicalSoft-delete flag; false on every record seen.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in sportality_schedule().

See also

Other Basketligaen Functions: sportality_athlete_career(), sportality_athlete_details(), sportality_athlete_profile(), sportality_boxscore(), sportality_game_header(), sportality_game_overview(), sportality_game_summary(), sportality_last_game_day(), sportality_layout_info(), sportality_next_game_day(), sportality_pbp(), sportality_player_box(), sportality_player_crosswalk(), sportality_player_h2h(), sportality_post_game_team_stats(), sportality_roster(), sportality_schedule(), sportality_sites(), sportality_ssgt_provider(), sportality_ssgt_uuid(), sportality_standings(), sportality_stats_info(), sportality_team(), sportality_team_played_games(), sportality_team_stats(), sportality_team_upcoming_games()
